title: Settings scroll fade — choose the strength at your selected width

steps.path: Fade strength with the selected side coverage
steps.hint: Scroll inside each drawer to see the fade; scroll outside to reach the next version. Try Meadow Mist, Halftone and a solid theme above.
steps.headline: At the selected width, how strong should the fade be?
steps.risk: Review-only comparison. All versions keep the 42px depth and your selected 4% side taper; only how fast content disappears changes. The provisional 20% header-line taper remains unchanged. This does not approve an app-wide rule or change production styling.

variants.label: Steady fade
variants.summary: Content fades at an even rate from the edge.

variants.label: A bit stronger
variants.summary: The strength shown when you picked the 4% width. More content disappears near the edge.

variants.label: Much stronger
variants.summary: Content disappears quickly near the edge; the change might feel abrupt when scrolling.
